prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1056; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: Understood. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision in the parking lot in League City, Texas?
A: Yes, I was driving my car. I had just pulled into a space near the store entrance.
Q: What time of day was it, and what were the weather and lighting conditions like?
A: It was late afternoon. It was dry and still light out, so visibility was fine.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you were parking.
A: I was backing into the space slowly, checking my mirrors. Another vehicle came down the aisle and hit the rear passenger side of my car. I felt a hard jolt and my head snapped forward and then back.
Q: Did you stop your vehicle before the impact, or were you still moving?
A: I was moving, but very slowly, maybe a couple of miles per hour.
Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: Not really. I heard a horn right before the impact, but I didn't see it coming in time.
Q: Did you receive any treatment at the scene or afterward?
A: The paramedics checked me out at the scene. Later I went to an urgent care clinic because my neck was really stiff and sore.
Q: Can you describe your symptoms right now?
A: My neck is tight, especially when I turn my head to the left. I also get a dull headache by the end of the day. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and using a heating pad.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: No, nothing serious. I've had occasional stiffness from sitting at a desk, but nothing I ever needed treatment for.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal, and I hope this gets sorted out quickly.
Q: Thank you for your time today.
